descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a Mobile Test Automation Engineer to join our international development team that delivers first class applications for our businesses and clients.
 What you will do: 
Analyze product requirements and specifications.
Propose mobile test automation strategies and plans, contributing to the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts.
Design test scenarios and test cases, ensuring traceability to all business requirements.
Maintain existing automation scripts whenever required, following functional changes to the respective flows or applications.
Define test data requirements.
Ensure compliance with testing best practices and the Client's testing standards.
Integrate automated tests into the Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipeline to enable early defect detection and provide rapid feedback to development teams.
Analyze automated test execution results and debug automated test scripts.
Identify, document, and report software defects and inconsistencies using bug-tracking systems.
Prepare clear and concise test documentation, including test plans, test cases, and test scripts, to support knowledge transfer and ensure consistency across testing processes.
Create and support test reports, as well as contribute to risk assessments.
 What you must have: 
3+ years of experience in UI Mobile Test Automation across both iOS and Android platforms, using the following tech stack: JavaScript, WebdriverIO, Cucumber, BrowserStack, and Allure (or any other reporting tool).
Proven experience with NPM, including installing and updating dependencies, configuring, and running custom scripts in package.json.
Proven experience in API automation testing using the following tech stack: REST Assured (Java) and/or Super-Agent (JS), Axios, or Supertest.
Proven experience working with Git workflows (push, pull, merge, fetch, rebase, etc.).
Previous experience with manual REST API testing using Postman and/or Bruno.
Experience with manual testing on BrowserStack and/or on-site iOS and Android devices.
Extensive knowledge of mobile testing concepts, methodologies, tools, and best practices.
Extensive experience with test management tools such as Octane and Jira.
Experience in planning and executing testing activities across all layers.
Good testing and troubleshooting skills throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple testing efforts.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, and Project Managers.
Effective communication skills, particularly when presenting test automation strategies and plans.
Detail-oriented, with a strong user-centric mindset.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of Agile methodologies.
Very good to advanced level of English.
Previous experience working on banking projects.
 Nice to have: 
ISTQB certification.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, particularly Azure DevOps and GitLab pipeline configurations.
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and commited people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
 ***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.
